title: feat(plugin-auth, plugin-security): createIdentityObjectsPlugin() preset; SecurityPlugin refuses at boot a kernel without sys_user / sys_member
body:
Fixes #22074

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What changed

1. **plugin-auth exports the identity-object registration as a plugin it composes itself.** `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` registers `authIdentityManifest()` (new, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/manifest.ts:147`): the manifest header, `authIdentityObjects` and `authObjectExtensions`. `AuthPlugin` spreads the same builder into the one manifest it registers (`auth-plugin.ts:656`), so a reduced kernel and a full kernel register one list under one package id, and nothing is registered twice on a full kernel.
2. **plugin-security declares what its authorization store reads and refuses at boot without it.** `security-plugin.ts:1088` declares `sys_user` and `sys_member`; a `kernel:ready` handler subscribed at the head of `start()` (`:1654`) asks the engine registry for both and throws `AuthzIdentityObjectsMissingError` naming the missing objects and the plugin that registers them. plugin-security registers neither object.

## Public surface, for the at-tier contract review

- **New exports on `@objectstack/plugin-auth`** (through `export *` of the new module `src/identity-objects-plugin.ts`): `createIdentityObjectsPlugin(options?)`, `IdentityObjectsPlugin`, `IdentityObjectsPluginOptions` (`manifestDatasource`, same meaning as on `AuthPluginOptions`), `IDENTITY_OBJECTS_PLUGIN_NAME` (`com.objectstack.auth.identity-objects`). `authIdentityManifest` lives in `manifest.ts`, which the package index does not export.
- **The boot refusal, and whom it newly refuses.** A kernel where `SecurityPlugin.start()` ran and the engine registry does not hold `sys_user` or `sys_member` at `kernel:ready`: `bootstrap()` now rejects. Before, it booted and every authenticated permission read failed with `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, 503). Newly refused, measured: the three in-repo harnesses listed under Cross-lane files. Newly refused, by code reading only (not run): `DevPlugin` with `services: { auth: false }` and security left on, because `DevPlugin.start()` hands the real context to `SecurityPlugin.start()`.
- **Not refused.** Any kernel mounting `AuthPlugin` (`os serve` pairs the two; `@objectstack/verify`'s `bootStack` mounts `AuthPlugin`); a kernel registering the two objects any other way (the gate asks the registry, not who registered); a declarations-only boot (`os migrate` composes host plugins with `start()` suppressed). The last is measured: `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.host-composition.integration.test.ts`, which composes `SecurityPlugin` without `AuthPlugin`, stays green on this tree.
- **A second, smaller refusal.** `IdentityObjectsPlugin.init()` refuses a kernel that also mounts `AuthPlugin` (both register the same objects under one package id, and, read from the registry code rather than run, the later registration replaces the package record). `optionalDependencies: ['com.objectstack.auth']` orders `AuthPlugin` ahead, so its `auth` service is registered when `init()` asks.

## Measure first: `@objectstack/verify`

Measured, read only: `bootStack` in `packages/verify/src/harness.ts` mounts `AuthPlugin` unconditionally (`kernel.use(new AuthPlugin(...))`, around `:569`), so its in-process handle already registers the identity objects. It is the sanctioned kit for an app suite; the new module's header says so. The export lands for kits that compose their own kernel (hotcrm's nine harnesses are that shape). `packages/verify` is not edited.

## Mechanism hypotheses

- **H1, confirmed.** `authIdentityObjects` in `manifest.ts` is the single list, registered through the `manifest` service under `AUTH_PLUGIN_ID`. Both paths now read it through `authIdentityManifest()`. Pinned: `AuthPlugin.init()` registers exactly one manifest whose `objects` is the same array (`toBe`) and whose identity half equals `authIdentityManifest()`, pages and dashboards still present; a real `AuthPlugin` + `SecurityPlugin` kernel registers plugin-auth's list once under `com.objectstack.plugin-auth`.
- **H2, measured: `sys_user` and `sys_member`, not `sys_member` alone.** `resolveUserAuthzGrants` (`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:757`, `:794`, `:796`) reads `sys_user` (whenever the caller seeded no email, no `ai_seat`, or a platform-admin list is configured) and `sys_member`, plus five objects plugin-security registers itself (`sys_user_position`, `sys_user_permission_set`, `sys_position`, `sys_position_permission_set`, `sys_permission_set`). plugin-security's own boot passes also read `sys_account` and `sys_organization`, but through local read helpers that degrade with a warn; they are not the authz store and are not declared. Ablation reading below: with the gate removed, the boot passes and the first `resolveUserAuthzGrants` call fails with `AuthzStoreUnavailableError`, code `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, status 503, object `sys_member`.
- **H3, measured: no kernel mechanism declares objects.** `dependencies` / `optionalDependencies` / `requiresServices` name plugins and services (`packages/core/src/plugin-order.ts`). The existing mechanism used is the kernel's documented boot-gate moment: a `kernel:ready` handler that throws fails `bootstrap()` on both kernels (`packages/core/src/kernel-base.ts`, `lite-kernel.ts`). The check stays inside plugin-security. It is subscribed in `start()`, not `init()`: `os migrate` composes host plugins for `init()` only and fires `kernel:ready` anyway, so an `init()` subscription would refuse a schema command that never reads the store.
- **H4, measured: three harnesses outside the two packages.** Candidates: every test file outside plugin-auth / plugin-security that imports `@objectstack/plugin-security` without going through `bootStack` or `AuthPlugin` (runtime 7 files, service-automation 2, rest 9, organizations 1, cli 3, dogfood 1, plugin-dev's whole suite), run against the built change. Red: `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-seeder-declaration-copy.test.ts` (1 file), `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/write-nodes-stored-metadata-family-refusal.integration.test.ts` (1 case) and `.../runas-system-stamping.integration.test.ts` (2 cases), all with `AuthzIdentityObjectsMissingError`. Inside plugin-security, three test files whose engine doubles fire every `kernel:ready` handler (14 cases) now answer the two names from `getSchema`.
- **H5, decided: package id `com.objectstack.plugin-auth`, kernel plugin name `com.objectstack.auth.identity-objects`, provenance `@objectstack/plugin-auth`.** The registry records one owning package per object and refuses a second package claiming it (ADR-0029 D3, `ObjectOwnershipConflictError`), so the manifest id decides the objects' provenance; a different id would make `sys_user`'s owner depend on which plugin a kernel mounts. The kernel plugin name differs from `AuthPlugin`'s only because the kernel keys plugins by name. The export ships from plugin-auth, the package that owns the list, rather than as a copy built from `@objectstack/platform-objects/identity` imports.

## Cross-lane files (outside plugin-auth / plugin-security), for the seat to declare

- `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-seeder-declaration-copy.test.ts`: mounts `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` before `SecurityPlugin` (runtime already depends on plugin-auth).
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/write-nodes-stored-metadata-family-refusal.integration.test.ts` and `packages/services/service-automation/src/runas-system-stamping.integration.test.ts`: the same mount.
- `packages/services/service-automation/package.json`: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` as a devDependency (no workspace cycle: plugin-auth's closure does not contain service-automation), with `pnpm-lock.yaml` (+3 lines).
- `packages/services/service-automation/vitest.config.ts`: an anchored alias of `@objectstack/plugin-auth` to source, because `check:test-source-alias` refuses a new unaliased artifact import (its ledger is shrink-only).

## Tests (HEAD `90bb6549a8`)

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/authz-identity-objects-boot-refusal.test.ts` (3 cases, real kernel, ObjectQL, SQLite): refused with both names; only the missing name; boots when the registry holds both, registered by a test package.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/identity-objects-plugin.test.ts` (9 cases): the card's four pins, plus a control (without the preset the `sys_user` insert is refused `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` / 404), the datasource override on both paths, the ordering edge, and the co-mount refusal. The app in pin 1 registers its manifest through the `manifest` service, as `AppPlugin.init()` does; `AppPlugin` itself lives in `@objectstack/runtime`, which depends on plugin-auth, so this suite cannot import it without a workspace cycle.
- Full suites, at `1a507892` (the one later commit, `90bb6549a8`, only re-spells `IdentityObjectsPlugin.optionalDependencies` as a literal; its pin file was re-run there, 9 passed): plugin-security 173 files, 3666 passed, 45 skipped; plugin-auth 127 files, 2633 passed, 10 skipped; service-automation 175 files, 2120 passed. Runtime: the edited file, 13 passed.
- Typecheck: `pnpm --filter` `typecheck` for plugin-auth, plugin-security, service-automation and runtime, all exit 0 (test layers OK, debt ledgers unchanged).

## Ablation of the boot-refusal pin

Committed first; `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the one `kernel:ready` subscription line in `security-plugin.ts` (anchor x1 to x0, marker x0 to x1, blob `b90b3e0f` to `e8696819`). The suites resolve plugin-security from source (relative import, and plugin-auth's vitest alias), so no build sat between edit and run. Mutated: the boot-refusal file went red 2 of 3 (the "boots when both are registered" case stays green, as it should), and plugin-auth's pin 3 went red 1 of 9. The ablated boot passed and the first permission read answered `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` / `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503 / `sys_member` (a scratch probe, deleted after). Restore: blob back to `b90b3e0f`, equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Gates (HEAD `90bb6549a8`)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 80 commands; all 80 ran and exited 0, reconciled with `--ran` (80 derived, 80 run, 0 NOT MEASURED, every line carrying its exit code). Run in addition because the diff touches plugin lifecycle code: `check:startup-registry-verdict`, `check:init-service-contract` (it caught an `optionalDependencies` spelled through a constant, now a literal), `check:durability-log-level`, all exit 0. The derivation names no `check:api-surface` family for these packages (that gate covers `packages/spec`); `check:dts-closure` and `check:published-files` are green. ESLint on the 14 changed TypeScript files: 0 errors, 0 warnings (population from `eslint.config.mjs`, which enables no type-aware linting, so untouched files' verdicts cannot move).

## Notes

- The branch sits on `033e5c53`; `origin/main` has since gained four commits, none touching a file in this diff. Not merged here; CI's merge ref carries the joint check.
- No `packages/spec`, `packages/platform-objects` or `packages/verify` edit.

## Acceptance notes

- A test kit loads `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` through plugin-auth's root entry, which also evaluates better-auth. A light subpath entry would need a `package.json` `exports` and tsup entry edit, outside this card's fence. Carrier: none.
- `DevPlugin` with `services: { auth: false }` and security on is now refused at boot (by code reading). `DevPlugin` could mount `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` itself in that branch; that is a plugin-dev change, outside this card. Carrier: none.
